# System Information
You are an expert in Java and in analyzing the impact of source code changes on other code entities in a project's production code.

# General Information
You receive information about a set of changes, called seed changes, that were made to fix a bug reported in Jira.
You also receive the Jira bug report title and description and an initial impact set consisting of the fully qualified names of code entities that are statically related to the seed changes.

# Task
Your task is to refine the initial impact set.
A code entity is part of the impact set if it requires modification or, if it does not already exist, must be created as a consequence of the seed changes.
First, remove code entities unless the provided information indicates that they must be modified.
Second, add code entities that must be modified or created according to the provided evidence.

Your goal is to report a final impact set that consists of the fully qualified names of code entities that must be modified or created because of the seed changes.

# Inputs
- Jira bug report title: Not expected UnboundedSolutionException
- Jira bug report description: SimplexSolver throws UnboundedSolutionException when trying to solve minimization linear programming problem. The number of exception thrown depends on the number of variables.\n\nIn order to see that behavior of SimplexSolver first try to run JUnit test setting a final variable ENTITIES_COUNT = 2 and that will give almost good result and then set it to 15 and you'll get a massive of unbounded exceptions.\nFirst iteration is runned with predefined set of input data with which the Solver gives back an appropriate result.\n\nThe problem itself is well tested by it's authors (mathematicians who I believe know what they developed) using Matlab 10 with no unbounded solutions on the same rules of creatnig random variables values.\n\nWhat is strange to me is the dependence of the number of UnboundedSolutionException exceptions on the number of variables in the problem.\n\nThe problem is formulated as\nmin(1*t + 0*L) (for every r-th subject)\ns.t.\n-q(r) + QL >= 0\nx(r)t - XL >= 0\nL >= 0\nwhere \nr = 1..R, \nL = {l(1), l(2), ..., l(R)} (vector of R rows and 1 column),\nQ - coefficients matrix MxR\nX - coefficients matrix NxR
- Seed changes and their Git diff hunks: [{"fqn": "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.subtractRow(int,int,double)", "git_diff_hunk": "@@ -456,2 +461,8 @@ class SimplexTableau implements Serializable {\n- tableau.setRowVector(minuendRow, tableau.getRowVector(minuendRow)\n- .subtract(tableau.getRowVector(subtrahendRow).mapMultiply(multiple)));\n+ for (int i = 0; i < getWidth(); i++) {\n+ double result = tableau.getEntry(minuendRow, i) - tableau.getEntry(subtrahendRow, i) * multiple;\n+ // cut-off values smaller than the CUTOFF_THRESHOLD, otherwise may lead to numerical instabilities\n+ if (FastMath.abs(result) < CUTOFF_THRESHOLD) {\n+ result = 0.0;\n+ }\n+ tableau.setEntry(minuendRow, i, result);\n+ }"}]
- Initial static code change impact set: ["org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealMatrix.getRowVector(int)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealMatrix.setRowVector(int,org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.Entry.getIndex()", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.Entry.getValue()", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.checkVectorDimensions(org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.copy()", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.getEntry(int)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.mapMultiply(double)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.mapMultiplyToSelf(double)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.setEntry(int,double)", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.sparseIterator()", "org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector.subtract(org.apache.commons.math3.linear.RealVector)", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexSolver.doIteration(org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau)", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.DEFAULT_ULPS", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.SimplexTableau(org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.LinearObjectiveFunction,java.util.Collection,org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.GoalType,boolean,double)", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.SimplexTableau(org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.LinearObjectiveFunction,java.util.Collection,org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.GoalType,boolean,double,int)", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.columnLabels", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.dropPhase1Objective()", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.epsilon", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.getWidth()", "org.apache.commons.math3.optimization.linear.SimplexTableau.tableau"]

# Output Format
Return exactly one valid single-line JSON array of strings.
Each string must be the fully qualified name of an impacted code entity.
Do not include any additional text, formatting, or meta-information.
Do not include seed changes in the output.

Example output (four impacted code entities):
["com.example.Foo.someMethod(java.lang.String, int)", "com.example.bar.attribute1", "com.example.bar.Class.NestedClass", "com.example.bar.Class.Class()"]

Example output (two impacted code entities):
["com.example.package.ParentClass.ChildClass.field", "com.example.package.ParentClass.apply(long, com.example.package.ParentClass)"]

Example output (zero impacted code entities):
[]
